blocks.content:
The Finance Commission acts as a balancing wheel between the financial powers of the Centre and the States.

It reduces:
• Vertical imbalances (Centre vs States)
• Horizontal imbalances (between richer and poorer states)

Thus, it promotes cooperative federalism.
The Finance Commission acts as a balancing wheel between the financial powers of the Centre and the States.

items: Vertical Imbalance refers specifically to the financial gap between the Centre and States.
Horizontal Imbalance refers to economic and resource disparities between different States.
The term 'balancing wheel of fiscal federalism' is directly associated with the Finance Commission in exam questions.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Acts as a balancing wheel for financial powers between the Centre and the States.
Addresses and reduces vertical imbalances between Centre and States.
Addresses and reduces horizontal imbalances between richer and poorer states.
Serves to strengthen and promote cooperative federalism.
